translated_text: La mole nuit 6 27.11.40 My dearest, since Mama is with me. Meant for you, red, more. You will receive it [?] according to this letter, my morning. It was quite sad last night. Everything was so strange once - and these moments. You were again from how one must say goodbye to another, always in my thoughts, like love. Despite that, this time, all love. Wounds that can never heal. I am sure that you will soon be with me again. I feel so terribly strongly the sadness. A ravenous parting will not be enough for me, my little Bobchen - - Sad. I always have the feeling that it's over quickly for us, that it's all too much, constantly, the example too. I miss this beautiful apartment now with. That the happiness (what she thought of) which we both feel so strongly must be in there. Everything lasted so terribly little!! I answer that; that it's not like that anymore, that it will come again. But it won't come like that again. It will be something different again, according to perhaps, but ultimately not the same. And so it always is. Unfortunately, I always feel... I cheer, as expected, still too good. To find joy in the world, the baby has brought that. Now alone downstairs. Now I am nimble, almost completely... There was a thunderstorm last night, and I was afraid of it! I don't know why, I'm very used to my Bob taking me in his arms as soon as... and after... My darling, I feel that warm... inside me again in his arms, say... In case, Mama, it has never been necessary... when this letter arrives, bring me a pair of stockings and tie them on. Your letter didn't arrive, it somehow got lost. I am often still thinking of my little Bob and kiss you again... Tired times and more. Your love.
